These nine files are test data of the Apache POI project
(https://github.com/apache/poi, `test-data/slideshow` and `test-data/spreadsheet`),
Apache License 2.0, fetched unchanged on 2026-10-08. They were made with
Microsoft Office and hold only POI's own made-up test sentences. They are here
so the readers in `material_formats.py` are checked against files a real Office
wrote, not only against the minimal ones the tests build by hand.
